pattern: A fieldset composing labelled pickers (APG date picker dialogs), a native checkbox and select, and an optional Recurrence Picker fieldset.

roles.role: DateTime Picker or Date Picker groups

aria.value: Help text, error message, and the duration text

keyboard.action: Start, end (with their calendar buttons), all day, timezone, then the recurrence controls.
As DateTime Picker and Date Picker (segments, ArrowUp/ArrowDown, calendar popup).
Toggles all-day; the pickers switch between times and dates.

focus: Hidden pickers (timed or all-day) are not focusable. Toggling all-day keeps focus on the checkbox.
notes: Moving the start moves the end by the same amount, so the duration is kept; the duration text is part of the description.
knownCaveats: Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
